caption: What does your health history look like when everything connects? Sleep, meals, pulse, mood, orbiting your own timeline, connected around your own story. No fake scans, no predictions, just your trail. Your health, connected. Explore HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop. #healthgraph #connectedhealth #selftracking #3dvisualization #healthtimeline #digitaldiary #datastorytelling #healthtech #personalhistory #mindfultracking

lines.text: What does your health history look like when everything connects?
lines.beat: dark space, a single warm light rises, the question hangs over a slowly turning point of light

lines.text: Start with a person. A life, not a chart.
lines.beat: human silhouette fades in center frame, quiet, no UI anywhere

lines.text: Around them, everything they have logged: sleep, meals, pulse, mood.
lines.beat: orbit motif: SLEEP, MEALS, PULSE, MOOD chips and document cards orbit the figure in slow rings

lines.text: Every point is a real entry, not a decoration.
lines.beat: push-in: orbiting chips resolve into real data chips, 67 BPM, 977 kcal, 7h sleep, mood Very good

lines.text: Some points link. The connection was waiting to be seen.
lines.beat: camera dives into the orbit and emerges inside the health graph, 12 nodes 22 connections, green edges draw

lines.text: A pulse one day, a document another, sleep in between.
lines.beat: document to node: a cream paper report card flattens into a graph node, camera travels along the timeline axis

lines.text: Fly through the graph and the history assembles itself.
lines.beat: continuous flight through node space, time filters sweep, nodes and edges assemble behind the camera

lines.text: No fake scans. No predictions. Just your trail, connected.
lines.beat: orbit recedes around the silhouette, lights settle, clean dark frame

lines.text: Your health, connected. Explore HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop.
lines.beat: end card: Your health, connected. healthgraph.shop wordmark
